name: Comfort Seeker
description: Just wants a warm bed, a full belly, and one day without getting shot at
behavioral_signature: Optimizes for physical and emotional comfort above all else
under_stress: Takes terrible deals just to make the discomfort stop
at_rest: Cozy, content, genuinely pleasant to be around
will_always: choose the path of least suffering
unless: someone they love is in danger and comfort means cowardice
